app.tagline: Your business website, made by talking.
home.title: {app_name}
home.intro: Tell us about your business by voice or send a photo of your price list. We build a website that works well on phones, test it the way your customers will, and show you how ready it is.
home.step_1: Speak in Marathi, Hindi or English, or send a photo of your rate card.
home.step_2: Check each detail. Nothing goes on your site until you say yes.
home.step_3: Get a live website with a readiness score.
lang.label: Language
error.title: Something went wrong
error.generic: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Your site is safe. Please try again in a little while.
error.not_found: We could not find this page.
error.invalid_input: Some details look wrong. Please check them and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
error.spend_cap: Our helper is resting for today. Your site stays live. Please try again tomorrow.
error.csrf: This form has expired. Please go back, reload the page and try again.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to open this page.
upload.empty: The file is empty. Please choose another one.
upload.bad_type: This file type is not supported. Please send a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP) or a voice note.
upload.too_large: This file is too large. Please send a smaller one.
upload.bad_image: We could not read this photo. Please take it again.
